description: This file contains assembly code for managing the clock settings of the RTL838X SRAM, including functions to start DRAM, set DRAM rate, and manage PLL (Phase-Locked Loop) configurations, specifically tailored for a Realtek RTL838X chipset.

methods.name: rtcl_838x_dram_start
methods.description: Assembly label for initializing DRAM start process.

methods.name: rtcl_838x_dram_set_rate
methods.description: Function to configure the DRAM clock rate by adjusting PLL settings.
